Q: What is unicast traffic?
Option1: Traffic sent from one sender to one receiver
Option2: Traffic sent from one sender to all devices
Option3: Traffic sent from one sender to multiple specific devices
Option4: Traffic sent to the nearest device

Q: What is multicast traffic?
Option1: Traffic sent from one sender to multiple specific receivers
Option3: Traffic sent to the nearest device

Q: What is anycast traffic?
Option1: Traffic sent from one sender to the nearest receiver in a group
Option4: Traffic sent to one device only

Q: What is broadcast traffic?
Option1: Traffic sent from one sender to all devices on a network segment
Option2: Traffic sent from one sender to one device
Option4: Traffic sent to the nearest receiver
